name: [Cyanotype] Storage integrity check has not finished for 36 hours
message:
{{#is_alert}}No storage integrity check has finished for 36 hours.{{/is_alert}}
The worker runs it nightly (INTEGRITY_CHECK_HOUR). Check that the worker is up and the schedule is not off (INTEGRITY_CHECK_ENABLED=0), and look at the last run on Admin > Health: a failed run shows its error. Silent when the check was never run on this instance (the metric does not exist until the first run finishes).
